bundle.shortDescription: ProSE: the OpenMS search engine for bottom-up proteomics
bundle.longDescription: ProSE searches MS/MS spectra (mzML) against a protein database (FASTA) with the ProSE engine of OpenMS, rescores with Percolator and PeptDeep, and shows the PSMs, peptides and proteins with annotated spectra. Everything runs on this computer.
